nodes.label: auth
nodes.role: Cookie-based JWT auth with rotating refresh sessions, CSRF double-submit, Google OAuth, email verification and password reset. Owns the User, Session and AuthToken models.

nodes.label: leagues
nodes.role: The largest domain. Owns leagues, league teams, league players, team members, join requests, managers, seasons, standings and player stats. Also the authorization authority: every `assert*` / `can*` league-role helper lives in leagues.service.js.

labels: League, LeagueTeam, LeaguePlayer, LeagueTeamMember, LeagueJoinRequest, LeagueManager, LeagueStandings, LeaguePlayerStats, Season, LeagueDataIssueDismissal

nodes.label: games
nodes.role: Live game tracking and derived stats: event recording, clock, lineups, rosters, box score, final score, AI recap. finishGame is the hub that fans out to standings, team summaries, feed cards, auto-feed and milestone detection.

nodes.label: feed
nodes.role: The social pulse feed (/pulse). Owns Post, shareable/discoverable card generation, auto-published game posts, highlight clips, and the Cloudinary upload client.

nodes.label: teams
nodes.role: Standalone (non-league) teams, their rosters and materialized per-season summaries, plus public team and opponent pages.

nodes.label: billing
nodes.role: Resource-scoped Stripe billing (per Team / per League) via hosted Checkout. Stripe is the source of truth; the webhook router is mounted before express.json(). entitlements.service.js resolves plan gates for every other module.

nodes.label: milestones
nodes.role: Career-milestone detection for league players. Detects on game finalization, re-evaluates after edits, re-keys on identity changes, and publishes milestone posts through feed.

nodes.label: follows
nodes.role: Follow graph for leagues, teams and players; powers the Following page and feed personalization.

nodes.label: export
nodes.role: CSV export of league data, gated by billing entitlements.

nodes.label: analytics
nodes.role: Server-side PostHog event capture, consent-aware.

nodes.label: contact
nodes.role: Contact form; rate-limited, sends mail through the shared email service. Route-only module (no controller/service split).

nodes.label: health
nodes.role: Liveness/readiness probe.

nodes.label: games (UI)
nodes.role: Game tracking UI: the interactive court (tap-to-infer shot zones), clock controls, event log, box score, highlight reels, and the game list/detail pages.

nodes.label: leagues (UI)
nodes.role: The biggest client feature: 18 pages covering league admin (teams, players, managers, schedule builder, data completeness) and the public league/standings/team/player views.

nodes.label: feed (UI)
nodes.role: The /pulse feed: post cards, shareable card export (html2canvas), share-image hooks.

nodes.label: teams (UI)
nodes.role: Standalone team pages: create/edit, roster, public team and public player pages, stats tables.

nodes.label: auth (UI)
nodes.role: Login/register, Google completion, email verification, forgot/reset password, plus the AuthContext store.

nodes.label: billing (UI)
nodes.role: Pricing page (dev-only route), checkout redirect, billing success, status pills. Uses Stripe hosted Checkout — no client Stripe.js card flows.

nodes.label: players (UI)
nodes.role: Public user profiles, profile cards, player milestones, discoverable players.

nodes.label: shared client core
nodes.role: Composition root and shared plumbing: app/providers, app/router (lazily code-split routes, OPT-001), app/store, lib/apiClient, layouts, components/ui, analytics and media helpers.

nodes.label: Express app shell
nodes.role: createApp() composes the middleware chain in a load-bearing order: requestId → pino-http → helmet → cors → **billing webhook with express.raw (before express.json)** → express.json → cookieParser → passport → CSRF attach/protect → rate limit → /api/v1 router → notFound → error.

nodes.label: middleware
nodes.role: Cross-cutting request plumbing. auth.middleware verifies the JWT access cookie; csrf.middleware does double-submit; publicCache.middleware (OPT-019) caches anonymous public GETs and degrades to no-cache when auth is present; rateLimit, requestId, error and notFound complete the chain.

nodes.label: core services
nodes.role: Auth-adjacent services shared across modules: token.service (JWT access/refresh), authToken.service (verification + reset tokens), session.service (rotating refresh sessions), email.service (Resend/nodemailer transport).

nodes.label: shared + utils
nodes.role: Pure helpers with no domain state: ApiError/apiResponse/asyncHandler (the error contract), pagination, csv, crypto, escapeHtml, stripeUrl, webhookIdempotency — plus modules/shared (statSummary, gameClock, stats.constants, cloudinaryUrl, pagination.validation).

nodes.label: config + env
nodes.role: Boot-time configuration. env.js Zod-validates the environment (loaded from env/server/.env.* via ENV_FILE) and fails fast; db.js opens the Mongoose connection; cors, cookie and logger (pino) configure the rest.

nodes.label: backfill scripts
nodes.role: Idempotent operational scripts (all support --dry-run), run as ENV_FILE=… node src/scripts/<name>.js. Covers seeding, migrations (index drops, plan-enum unification) and backfills for derived data: standings, seasons, milestones, team-season summaries, finalScore, auto-feed.

nodes.label: MongoDB
nodes.role: The single datastore, via Mongoose 8. **There is no models/ directory** — every schema is declared inline in its owning *.repository.js. Derived/materialized data (standings, boxScore, finalScore, season summaries) is written back into documents rather than recomputed per request.

labels: League, LeagueTeam, LeaguePlayer, LeagueTeamMember, LeagueJoinRequest, LeagueManager, LeagueStandings, LeaguePlayerStats, Season, LeagueDataIssueDismissal

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.role: Hosted Checkout + Customer Portal + webhooks. Source of truth for subscription state; the webhook handler claims each event through utils/webhookIdempotency before applying it.

nodes.label: Cloudinary
nodes.role: Image storage and transformation for logos, avatars and feed media. Uploads go through feed/cloudinary.client.js; URL building is shared in modules/shared/cloudinaryUrl.js.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.role: Generates the natural-language game recap after a game is finalized, called at https://api.openai.com/v1/responses. Fired off-response so finishing a game never blocks on it.

nodes.label: PostHog
nodes.role: Product analytics on both sides — posthog-node on the server, posthog-js on the client behind a consent banner.

nodes.label: Google OAuth
nodes.role: Social sign-in via passport-google-oauth20, exchanged for the app's own session cookies.

nodes.label: Email (Resend)
nodes.role: Transactional mail — verification, password reset, billing notices, contact form.

flows.name: Finish a game → the derived-data fan-out
flows.why: The most consequential write path in the codebase. One request flips a game to completed, freezes its box score, then fans out to five independent recompute jobs. Almost every materialized field in the product is written here.

steps.label: GameTrackPage → finishGame()
POST /api/v1/games/:id/finish
finishGameForUser — assertGameAccess, then canFinalizeLeagueGame for league games
status=completed, pause clock, syncGameEventCount, syncGameFinalScore, computeBoxScore → game.boxScore, then save
fan-out 1 — scheduleLeagueRecomputeForGame rebuilds LeagueStandings + LeaguePlayerStats
fan-out 2 — scheduleTeamSummaryRecomputeForGame rewrites TeamSeasonSummary
fan-out 3 + 4 — refresh existing feed cards, then auto-publish the game post
fan-out 5 — detectForFinalizedGame reads boxScore lines against career totals
milestones publish their own Post through feed
off-response: buildPersistedGameSummary → OpenAI /v1/responses for the recap
Game, LeagueStandings, LeaguePlayerStats, TeamSeasonSummary, Post, PlayerMilestone all written

flows.name: Login → rotating session + CSRF
flows.why: Establishes the identity every other flow depends on. Notable because authorization is deliberately NOT middleware RBAC — User.roles is unused; permission checks happen later, in leagues.service assert* helpers.

steps.label: AuthPage submits credentials
POST /api/v1/auth/login — behind authLimiter, after attachCsrfToken/csrfProtection
Zod-validated at the controller, then auth.service verifies the bcrypt hash
session.service mints a rotating refresh session; token.service signs the JWT pair
Session document persisted alongside User
httpOnly access + refresh cookies set via config/cookie
AuthContext holds the user; apiClient replays through /auth/refresh on 401

flows.name: Checkout → Stripe webhook → entitlement gates
flows.why: Billing is resource-scoped (per Team / per League), not per user. The webhook is mounted before express.json() with express.raw so signature verification sees the untouched body — reordering that line silently breaks payments.

steps.label: PricingPage → team-checkout / league-checkout
billing.service creates a hosted Checkout Session (no client Stripe.js)
User pays on Stripe-hosted pages, then Stripe posts the event back
POST /api/v1/billing/webhooks — express.raw, mounted BEFORE express.json()
Signature verified, then each handler claims the event for idempotency and order-safety
Plan + subscription state written onto the Team or League document
entitlements.service resolves the gates every other module consults
Downstream gate example — CSV export refuses without the entitlement

flows.name: Public league page → cached materialized reads
flows.why: The main anonymous read path. It is fast because it serves pre-materialized standings rather than aggregating on request, and because publicCacheMiddleware (OPT-019) lets browsers and CDNs cache it — degrading to no-cache the moment a request carries auth.

steps.label: PublicLeaguePage / PublicLeagueStandingsPage fetch by slug
GET /api/v1/public/leagues/* behind publicCacheMiddleware
OPT-019 — cacheable for anonymous viewers, private/no-cache when authenticated
assertLeagueVisible gates archived/private leagues
Reads materialized LeagueStandings / LeaguePlayerStats — no per-request aggregation
Player views additionally pull milestone summaries

flows.name: Share a card → the /pulse feed
flows.why: The social loop, and the clearest example of the feed module being written to by others rather than only read. Cards are generated server-side from already-frozen game data, so a shared card cannot drift from the box score.

steps.label: ShareImageButton posts a game/player/team card
POST /api/v1/feed/* — authenticated
feed.controller consults billing before allowing the post
feed.service builds the card from frozen game/league data
Any uploaded media goes through the Cloudinary client
Post document persisted
FeedPage renders /pulse; html2canvas exports the shareable image client-side
